text:
incident-bot: ALERT: [P2] Canary rollout failure: repeated fallback to sticky variant in eu-west-1 causing elevated tail-latency and >5% error-rate for service: inference.api (triggered 1790123456) :rotating_light:

maria: paging oncall now - I’m looking. saw a spike in 5xx from canary.

devin: on it. what does the fallback look like? sticky fallback was supposed to prefer local stable variant.

ryan: logs show repeated routing loops where requests hit canary -> fail -> fallback to stable-quant -> sticky assignment persists and then subsequent requests routed back to canary due to rollout sticky rule. looks like sticky cookie not honoring region affinity. snippet from router logs:
```
2026-10-12T02:04:21Z router[eu-west-1] INFO route decision: user=acct-218, route=canary-v2, result=Fallback(sticky: true, variant=stable-quant, reason=LLM_TIMEOUT)
2026-10-12T02:04:22Z router[eu-west-1] INFO sticky:set session=acct-218 -> variant=stable-quant
2026-10-12T02:04:22Z router[eu-west-1] INFO incoming: session=acct-218, prefer=stable-quant, evaluation=canary-v2 eligible
2026-10-12T02:04:22Z router[eu-west-1] INFO route decision: user=acct-218, route=canary-v2, result=Route(canary-v2, reason=rollout)
```

lee: so session is sticky to stable-quant but rollout policy still places new requests on canary because rollout weight hasn't been updated. that would cause both variants to be assigned to same user over short timespan -> cache/KV mismatch and latency.

anya: affected customers? any external errors visible in SLO dashboards?

maria: we have a handful of enterprise customers in eu-west-1 reporting latency/regression. synth checks show 6% error-rate on chat generate across canary cohort.

devin: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) pause canary rollout 2) clear sticky sessions for canary cohort in router 3) force-route traffic to stable-quant in eu-west-1 until we investigate. agree?

ryan: agree. also disable automatic sticky assignment temporarily (policy toggle). I can run the commands.

deploy-bot: ACTION: canary-rollout pause request queued by @devin (runbook step 1).

devin: running pause now:
```
# pause rollout
redwoodctl rollout pause --env eu-west-1 --target canary-v2 --reason "incident 1790123456"
```

devin: pause succeeded (api: 202 Accepted).

maria: runbook step 2 - clear sticky sessions for cohort. ryan, want me to run or you?

ryan: I’ll run. command to clear sticky keys by tag: 
```
redwoodctl sticky clear --env eu-west-1 --tag rollout:canary-v2 --confirm
```

ryan: cleared ~12k sticky keys. router metrics show sticky-set rate dropping.

lee: forcing route to stable-quant now (temporary routing override):
```
redwoodctl route override --env eu-west-1 --scope cohort:canary-v2 --variant stable-quant --ttl 3600 --reason "incident 1790123456 immediate mitigation"
```
deploy-bot: ROUTE OVERRIDE applied by @lee (ttl=3600s).

anya: monitoring impact on SLOs and customer reports.

maria: initial numbers: error-rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% over 8 minutes, p95 latency back within SLO. customers on eu-west-1 reporting improvement. marking impact as partial and reducing severity.

devin: next steps: eng-runtime to reproduce sticky/fallback interaction in staging, verify sticky cookie semantics across routing hints, and add a guard: if fallback assigns sticky variant, ensure subsequent rollout-driven routing respects sticky assignment (or clear it).

ryan: filing infra ticket and assigning to eng-runtime: INFRA-7842. adding logs and sample session ids.

maria: notifying customers affected with an incident update. preparing RCA outline: root cause appears to be rollout sticky policy + fallback sticky assignment not being composable -> conflicting routing decisions.

lee: will follow up with a short-term patch: when fallback sets sticky, mark session as "pinned-fallback" and exclude from rollout sampling for 30m. then we can safely resume.

devin: good. after patch we should run a canary replay in staging with high failure rates and ensure no loops. schedule patch and canary test in next 4 hours.

anya: handing over to post-incident thread for RCA details. oncall rotation: @maria stays on till 02:30Z, @devin to do deeper debug.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P3. mitigation applied: rollout paused, sticky keys cleared, routing override to stable variant in eu-west-1. follow-up owners: eng-runtime (devin, ryan), eng-sre (lee), customer-success (anya).

maria: thanks all. will post final timeline and customer communication in the incident channel. :white_check_mark:
